dex.entry: A fuzzy moss-ball that slowly rolls through the forest floor of Lowleaf Hollow, leaving a trail of faint bioluminescent spores; too round and soft to be scary but deeply easy to underestimate. art.silhouette: Near-perfect sphere of dense green moss with scattered amber spore-dots; no obvious limbs but two tiny leaf-stubs; a single sleepy eye peeking out from the moss; rolls via a wobble-wiggle motion; reads as a mossy marble at 16px.
